project_description: StudySpark AI is an internal assistant used by the Learning Support Office (LSO) at Ashcombe University to help staff draft personalised study guidance messages for students who have reported academic difficulties. An LSO staff member types a short summary of a student's reported difficulty (for example, 'struggling with time management for coursework deadlines') along with the student's course and year. The tool, powered by OpenAI GPT-4o via Azure OpenAI (EU region), drafts a suggested guidance message that the staff member reviews, edits as needed, and sends personally. The tool does not contact students directly and does not make any decision about a student's academic standing, extensions, or support eligibility. It is accessible only to the seven LSO staff members via the university's internal single sign-on portal. It is in pilot use for one academic term before a decision is made on wider rollout.

free_text_answers.Q0: StudySpark AI drafts personalised study guidance messages for Learning Support Office staff to review and send to students who have reported academic difficulties. It uses Azure OpenAI GPT-4o (EU-hosted) and is used only by 7 LSO staff. No message is sent to a student without staff review and edit.
